snippet.title: CAAAHR! - Trailer | GamingUp Showcase 2026
snippet.description:
Your voice is the engine. Literally.

CAAAHR! is a chaotic voice-controlled co-op racing game where two players share control of one very questionable car. One player accelerates using their voice — the louder they get, the faster the car goes — while the other steers through obstacle courses, jumps and traps.

But steering isn't enough. Short sounds and noises trigger jumps, boosts and other abilities, turning every run into a test of timing, communication and how much your friendship can survive.

Play online, locally or attempt the journey solo, chase leaderboard times, discover shortcuts and unlock new skins as you try to conquer one giant handcrafted obstacle course.

Wishlist CAAAHR! now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4627980/CAAAHR/

Coming to PC in Summer 2026.
